<title level="1" right="Cantrip 1" pfs="Standard">
[Artistic Recollection](/Spells.aspx?ID=2632)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=550" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 123

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You touch your finger to a blank surface and create an image of a person, place, or object. This image appears instantly in the style of a pastel-hued oil painting and disappears cleanly once the spell ends. The portrait is the size of one average sketchbook page and must represent a subject the caster has seen in person or has studied extensively.
